tei:div.tei:p: 391) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rje btsun 'phags ma'i rjes gnang gter gyi bum bzang bzhugs: 392) na mo padma kā ra ye:

chos sku'i zhing na bde chen kun bzang mo: g.yu lo bkod du ārya tā re ma: rnam dag zhing du dzñā na sa ga ra: sku gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud: phyi rabs las can sgo gsum smin pa'i thabs: 'phags ma'i byin rlabs gter gyi bum bzang bstan: lag len sngon 'gro'i yo byad 'di ltar bsags: rtsa gsum gtor ma spyi ltar legs bshams nas: sman raka gtor ma phyi nang gsang mchod sogs: gzhung bzhin bkod la tshogs kyi yo byad dang: bum pa sku tsaka bhandha thugs rdo rje: shel rdo me long la sogs rdzas kun bsags: go rim ma nor rim bzhin legs bshams bya: sa ma ya: bdag mdun bum gsum bsgom bzlas gnad 'khyol tshe: bdag dbang blang zhing las bum bzhu btul nas: dam ldan gral 'khod khrus byas bgegs bskrad cing: srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom dang lo rgyus brjod: slob mas sgo gsum bla mar phul snyam du: maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni: kyaiḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: smin byed dbang gi bka' drin stsol: lan gsum brjod nas slob dpon gyis: e ma skal ldan las 'phro can: khyed cag gsang sngags dkyil 'khor du: 'jug par spro ba ngas smin gyi: spro ba bskyed la gus pas 393)nyon: gsang sngags dbang la ma brten par: 'bras bu thob pa 'byung mi srid: sngon byon rgyal ba thams cad kyang: lam mchog 'di yis grol ba brnyes: de phyir khyed cag sgo 'dir 'jugaḥ skal ba ldan no rigs kyi bu: ngas bsgo'i bka' las 'da' ma byed: smin byed dbang mchog bdag gis sbyin: ces brjod slob mas lan gsol ba: kyai: slob dpon mchog nyid dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khyed kyi bka' las 'da' mi bya: rje btsun 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa'i dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rim gnyis tshul bzhin bsgom par bya:

zhes brjod: de nas skyabs sdom 'bogs pa ni: hoḥ rgyal ba kun yum rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol: bdag sogs 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar: sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi: 'khor ba sdug bsngal mtsho las bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum dang: sems bskyed sbyin pa ni: hoḥ ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa: rnam grol rgyal ba'i gong 'phang thob pa'i phyir: bdag gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de: 'khor ba dong sprugs nus pa'i 394)dpal thob shog: lan gsum brjod: de nas yan bdun ni: hoḥ rje btsun 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor du: sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: lus dang longs spyod mchod par 'bul: sgo gsum mi dge'i la kun bshags: rang gzhan dge las rjes yi rangs: gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: dam pa mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs: dge rtsa 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: bla med sangs rgyas sa thob shog: lan gsum brjod: de bas dam chu sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rjes byin rlabs pa'i: dam tshig bdud rtsi chu rgyun 'di: skal ldan khyed kyi ngag tu blud: dam srung tshe 'dir dngos grub thob: nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung: de phyir dam tshig ma nyams srungs: badzra sa ma ya na ra kan: ces brjod dam chu ngag tu blud: de nas mig me sbyin pa ni: oṃ tsakṣu bhandha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā: zhes dang: oṃ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐: zhes brjod mig dar me tog sbyin: de nas slob ma smin pa la: ma dag gdos bcas sbyong ba'i thabs: ma hā shu n+ya'i sgras bskul te: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bdag mdun sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis slob ma'i rgyud kyi sdig sgrib bag chags las nyon gdos bcas sha khrag gi 395)phung po dang bcas pa thams cad 'ja' tshon nam mkha' la yal ba ltar chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i klong du zhig par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las:

padma zla ba rgyas pa'i steng: slob ma skad cig dran rdzogs su: rgyal kun phrin las gcig 'dus dpal: 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang sngon mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas skyabs sbyin: g.yon pas mtheb srin utpal 'dzin: 'dab ma snyan thad rab tu rgyas: dar gyi stod g.yogs smad sham dkris: rin chen rgyan cha sna tshogs mnabs: dbu skra thod bcings rtse bran mdzes: rigs bdag 'od dpag med pas brgyanaḥ spyan gyis 'gro la brtse bas gzigs: g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums stabs kyis ni: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong: snang la rang bzhin med par bzhugs: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang: byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcasaḥ kun kyang 'phags ma'i rnam rol du: byon nas slob ma'i sgo gsum la: dbyer med ro gcig brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum sku gsung thugs su smin: rdo rje gsum gyi rol par rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: 396) oṃ ārya tā re ma ma ḍā ki ni sarba sa ma ya e a ra li pheṃ pheṃ a we sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod ye shes brtan par bya: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni: hoḥ bdag mdun thugs las 'od zer gser gyi thur: khyed kyi ma rig sgrib pa'i mig bsal nas: rang rig mi 'gyur chos sku'i don mthong nas: sgrib med ye shes spyan dang ldan par shog: dzñā na tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas rig me dor ba ni: kyai ho: mchog gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis: slob ma'i rig pa'i me tog 'di: sngon nas 'brel ba gang yod pa'i: lhag pa'i lha der babs nas kyang: dngos grub rnam gnyis deng 'dir stsol: oṃ padma puṣpe siddhi trāṃ: zhes dor lhag lha bstim pa ni: pra ti ghri ha ṇa i maṃ: zhes brjod bla mas me tog 'thor: de nas dngos dbang zhu ba la: maṇḍal phul la gsol gdab ni: kyai: gsang chen don ston slob dpon dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la:

rje btsun 'phags ma'i dngos gzhi'i dbang: yongs rdzogs gnang ba'i bka' drin stsol: de nas bla mas 'di skad brjod: khyed rang rnams kyi dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig: bdag mdun rnams kyi thugs ka nas 397)dbang rdzas rnams ye shes 'od kyis sbrel nas rim pa bzhin du byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum la thim pas dag rdzogs smin pa'i sa bon rgyud la skyes par bsam mo: de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ bum pa rin chen gzhal yas khang: bum bcud ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu: skal ldan bu la sbyin pa yis: 'phags ma'i sku yi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas rigs bdag gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku: snang ba mtha' yas rigs kyi bdag: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad la: dbang bsgyur dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas 'phags ma'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las sku: yon tan ye shes kun gyi mdzod: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs thob nas: tshe 'dir don gnyis dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags: ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas 'phags ma nyer gcig gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las dpal: 'phags ma lha mo nyer gcig gis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 398)mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun: 'bad med nyid du thob par shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas sgo ma bzhi'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med bzhi yi rang gzugs gar: sgo ma bzhi yis dbang bskur ro: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las: bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub par shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bha ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas bhandha thogs la: hūm̐: mtshan ldan ka pa la yi nang: rgyal yum 'phags ma'i gsung gi bcud: a li ka li'i 'od zer 'phro:

skal ldan bu la sbyin pa yis: gsung dbang yongs su rdzogs thob shog: rtsa sngags: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas snying po 'bru bcu gtad la: hūm̐ḥ gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bcudaḥ 'phags ma'i thugs kyi yang snying 'dis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: bzlas pa sngags kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas rdo rje gtad la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: gser gyi rdo rje 'di gtad pas: bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes don: mngon gyur chen po'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas shel rdo me long gtad la: hūm̐: dwangs gsal 'gag med a darsha: gsal stong rig pa brjod med brda: man shel 399)'od lnga lhun gyis grub: sku dang ye shes gzhi la rdzogs: mtshon byed rtags kyi brda dbang 'di: skal ldan bu la bskur ba yis: mtshon bya don gyi rig pa rtsal gyi dbang: skal ldan sems kyi bu la thob par shog: a phaṭaḥ rtsa sngags: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ces brjod brda ngo sprad pa ni: e ma e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu: ma yengs rig pa'i don la ltos: sems dang nam mkha' chos nyid gsum: don la tha dad dbye bsal med: snod bcud nam mkha'i rol ba ltar: 'khor 'das gnyis med rig pa'i rtsal: don la blta bya lta byed bral: thams cad dag mnyam chos sku'i ngang: sku gsum rig pa logs na med: rang sems ma bcos de ka'o: shes par mdzod cig rigs kyi bu: de nas gtor ma gtad la: hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam dag gzhong pa ru: lhun grub rdzogs pa'i ba liṃ ta: ye shes lnga yi rgyan gyis spras: rgyal yum 'phags ma sgrub pa'i rten: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs thob nas: sgrub dang dkyil 'khor thams cad la: dbang 'byor dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags: ma hā bha liṃ ta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥswā hā: de nas mtha' brten 400) rdzas rtags gtad:

sku drin gso phyir maṇḍal phul: dam tshig khas blangs shis pa brjod: las rjes mi mngon gsang ba gnad: de yis dbang gis las rim rdzogs: sa ma ya: e ma gsang ba gnad kyi chos: las can smin grol 'god pa'i lam: gu ru padma saṃ bha was: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag la gdams: gces pa'i nor dang mtshungs na yang: rigs ldan rdo rje zhi ba mtshor: gcig brgyud spel ba snying la chongs: da dung ma spel gter du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus: khyod sprul su kha badzra dang: phrad nas don gnyis 'byung bar nges: dus ngan rkyen gyis ma bsgyur na: thabs grogs chos bdag rim gyis 'dzoms: yul gru gsum gyi gdul bya'i sgo: mkha' 'gro'i brda yis bskul nas smin: de sogs 'gro don ngang gis 'byung: dbang 'di lan gcig thob pa'i mi: dam tshig tshul bzhin ldan gyur na: 'chi tshe dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas: mdun bsus bde chen dag pa'i zhing: g.yu lo bkod du 'khod par 'gyur: the tshom med do sa ma ya: sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dang yi ge'i 'du byed nye gnas tshul khrims rdo rje/ chos dbyings sgron ma rnams kyi bzhed skong du dus mtha'i gter brdzun su kha badzra gyis ser dgon dben gnas mtshams khrod ljongs nas lus med mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge'o// maṅga lam//
